Roofing in Wexford, PA

Roof replacement, repair, storm damage, gutters, and siding for Wexford and the rest of Allegheny County.

The short answer

Roughneck Roofing provides roof replacement, roof repair, storm damage restoration, gutters, and siding in Wexford, PA and the surrounding Allegheny County area. Inspections and written estimates are free, emergency tarping is available 24/7, and we hold a 5.0-star rating from 9 customer recommendations. Call 878-226-0855.

Larger homes, complex multi-facet roof lines, and heavy tree cover. Valleys and gutters are the two things we end up correcting most often out here.

Roofing services we provide in Wexford

  • Roof Replacement — Full tear-off and rebuild with architectural shingles, new underlayment, ice-and-water shield, and a properly balanced ventilation system.
  • Roof Repair — Fast, honest leak diagnosis and lasting repairs - flashing, valleys, boots, and storm damage. If a repair will hold, we repair it.
  • Storm Damage & Insurance Claims — Wind and hail damage inspection, documentation your adjuster can actually use, and a contractor who meets them on the roof.
  • Roof Inspections — A real inspection - on the roof and in the attic - with photos of everything we find and a straight answer about remaining service life.
  • Gutters & Downspouts — Seamless aluminum gutters sized and pitched correctly, plus guards that actually keep debris out without starving the system.
  • Siding & Exteriors — Vinyl and fiber cement siding, plus the soffit, fascia, and trim work that keeps the whole envelope tight.
  • Commercial Roofing — TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen for flat and low-slope buildings - plus maintenance programs that catch problems before tenants do.

What Wexford homeowners call us about most

The pattern here is consistent: leaks that start at a failed pipe boot or a chimney that was never properly flashed, wind damage along ridges and rake edges after a front moves through, and roofs that reached twenty years all at once because the neighbourhood was built at the same time. Ice dams show up every winter in homes where the attic is under-insulated and the soffit intake is blocked — which is a much cheaper problem to fix than most people assume.

How fast can you get to Wexford?

Emergency tarping is 24/7 across our whole service area, including Wexford. Standard inspections are usually scheduled within a few days. The week after a major storm runs longer, because the entire region calls at once — if a front just went through, call early.
